correctness.rationale: For fixed t>0 and real C^3 mean-zero h, the radial-squared perturbation has area pi*t and the top-two Fock Toeplitz eigenvalue sum admits an O_{t,h}(|epsilon|^3) expansion. The exact disk eigenvalues lambda_n=1-e^{-t} sum_{j=0}^n t^j/j! decrease with isolated gap lambda_1-lambda_2=e^{-t}t^2/2. Differentiating the coherent-state trace-class integral gives T_1(n,m)=e^{-t}sqrt(a_n a_m)*hhat_{m-n}; isolated-cluster perturbation cancels occupied-plane mixing. Direct second order term -t e^{-t}sum|hhat_k|^2 and cross-cluster gaps give the coefficient D_k(t). D_1=0, D_2=t(3+2t)/((t+2)(t+3))>0 and D_k strictly increases to t via decreasing Poisson-tail ratios. The trace-class remainder and fixed smooth h justify the infinite sum. Independent exact SymPy D2 and Dk monotonic samples plus separate finite-section quadrature at t=1, k=1,2,3,5 agree with quadratic coefficients to <4e-7. Finite matrices alone do not prove the infinite claim; no global shape optimality is asserted.
